answer: The Code contribution passing automated tests backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet wander gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. When the nectar settles over the willow, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
